C0929.title: Live-Stream Tipping Money Laundering Case: Platform Hosts Involved in Laundering
C0929.summary: On May 17, 2023, media reported that hosts on a live-streaming platform were investigated by police for participating in money laundering. Criminals exploited the platform's tipping feature to funnel illicit proceeds through host gratuities, with the amount involved reaching hundreds of millions of yuan. The case reveals how live-streaming platforms can be misused as a channel for financial crime.

references.title: Who is the top streamer that laundered hundreds of millions through livestream tipping?
